name: Ishilai Lyceum
title: Ishilai Lyceum
summary: A training academy for Yalaini hieromancers of the Seaborne Empire, on a mountain top on the southern coast, reachable only by the Lyceum Recall Gem (acpedia). In the kit, a walled academy stands on a mountain shelf at z 240: two six-storey red-roofed keeps, green spire towers, halls and a courtyard of Menhir mana fields round a blue crystal. On the summit 75 m above stand a domed octagon hall with a Portalspace Rift and candle sentinels, and a bamboo octagon. The slope falls 240 m west to the sea.

shots.standingOrder: Hang over the western sea cliffs looking down at the surf-line slope, then tilt up to reveal the red-roofed keeps of the Ishilai Lyceum on their mountain shelf with the summit halls above; hold level with the shelf, 170 m out over the slope.
shots.notes: Tilt reveal from a hover 170 m west of the academy over the steep sea slope, level with its shelf. The frame starts looking down the rock face and tilts up to the red-roofed keeps and green spires of the Ishilai Lyceum, with the summit halls above. The afternoon sun (0.63) is behind-right.
